sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, who sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders are in excellent form with a recent sequence of WIN-DRAW-WIN-WIN-WIN and will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who are rooted to the bottom with just 4 points from 10 matches and have lost their last five games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a trip to Dawley Town, with the visitors looking to close the two-point gap to leaders Sandbach after their recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points, host Eccleshall in what should be a competitive fixture between two sides in the upper half. Fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community, while Bilston Town (sixth) travel to Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. Barnton welcome Shawbury United; the former are on a recent win while the latter have lost their last four games. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a battle of sides struggling near the foot of the table, while Brereton Social's recent upturn continues as they face Widnes Town—the division's bottom club on two points—at home. Cheadle Heath Nomads, sitting 17th with inconsistent form, travel to Telford Town (18th, six points), and Crewe host Allscott Heath as two sides looking to climb away from the relegation zone collide.
